source: Every term the rooms and engines put on screen, in one plain sentence each, written for a reader who has never had a finance conversation. Lane 2, section 4 (DECISIONS.md L-4). The term list came from grepping rooms/*.html and engines/*.js for acronyms and capitalised phrases, plus the words a coaching client asks about.
confidenceNote: Definitions, not figures. Where a term has a legal meaning (a tax term, a plan name) the sentence says what it means for the reader, not the statute; the data tables carry the numbers and the sources.
note: Read by shared/glossary.js (SLAF.Glossary). `term` is the word as it appears on screen; `also` lists other spellings and the long form; `plain` is the sentence; `domain` groups them. No sentence uses its own term or any of its aliases (tests/glossary.test.js). Reading level: short sentences, common words, one idea each. The FIRE lexicon (docs/SOLAR-SYSTEM.md Part 5, D-320) adds to entries: spec (how the app computes or represents it), lives (METRIC:id, LEVEL:id, MOON:id, ROOM:id, LENS, WHAT_MATTERS, GLOSSARY), sourceLens (a data/benchmarks.json source) and appliesWhen (a moon gate, or always), which drives the Advice Translator tags: for you now, not yet, outgrown.
